prompt_en: Create a luxury wuxia fashion editorial of an unmistakably adult woman in her mid-twenties, beautiful and softly charming. She is a youthful adult form carrying the authority of centuries, the restored master of a northern ice sect. Use the attached portrait solely as facial casting: preserve pale skin, tapered oval face, adult-scale cool-gray eyes, slim nose, full pale-rose lips, and the nose-side beauty mark. Restyle her ash-blonde hair into a high swordmaster half-up arrangement with airy bangs. Stage a newly authored standing three-quarter composition: her body crosses the left third, head angled away from the lens, expression designed for this event. On a frost-carved sword terrace inside the Northern Sea Ice Palace, she holds a calm, low-expression face and an upright, economical sword stance. Her trusted adult peer's dropped sword lies across the frozen floor. At measured arm's-length distance, she guides the same trusted adult peer's dropped sword hilt-first toward his open hand with one narrow ribbon of ice qi. As the hilt nears the same trusted adult peer, only her lower eyelids soften as her eyes flick briefly toward him. His surprised fingers begin to close around the returning hilt; the sword reaches his hand while paired split-jade tassels glow across the small gap. The paired split-jade tassels identify the same adult peer and her own matching sword. Equal-height paired swords and measured spacing frame them as adult peers. Keep her the dominant beauty focal point; limit him to a clearly adult partial profile and hand at the right edge. A weathered sect-master jade seal and ancient ice sword imply old authority; a translucent ice wall, embedded practice blades, and spiraling frost from her footwork reveal martial power. Use a vertical medium-wide 50mm frame with winter moonlight, pale-jade rim light, airborne ice dust, tactile silk and steel, realistic skin and hands, and a poised luxury-editorial finish.
